name: area_of_a_single_face
why: A single face: 40x40 makes 1600 mm2, not 3200. It is the same measurement as the two-faces case, asked on one: if the selection were not emptied first, the area would still be that of two -- believable, of the right part, and wrong by double.
_already_seen_red: `Area` and `TotalArea` alternate, and this case caught it. Measured on 15/9/2026: with ONE face `Area` is 1600 and `TotalArea` answers -1; with TWO faces `Area` answers -1 and `TotalArea` is 3200. The one that holds is always the other. Reading only one, the field disappeared depending on how many things were asked -- «field missing: measurements.area_mm2» -- and this case is what keeps it said.

expect.tolerance_why: two faces of 1600, and it is «area_total» because with two entities `Area` does not answer
ONE 40x40 face, right after measuring two: this is where you see whether the selection was emptied

expect.why: the units travel with the answer: an area in square metres and one in square millimetres are both believable numbers
